summary: {person} receives advice from an agency whose own commissioners have yet to hear it.
realLife: Federal regulatory staff recommended evacuation to Pennsylvania before they could consult the commissioners, according to an NRC historical presentation.
gates: A recommendation has reached the executive before supervisory confirmation.
weights: Less time before the decision deadline makes acting on provisional advice more likely.
inGame: needs: agency approval before a recommendation goes outside.

turns.what: The chair returns the call before staff send their advice.
turns.pulledBy: The chair is on the briefing call.
turns.writesBack: The governor receives a recommendation approved by the chair.

turns.what: Staff relay what they observed and hold back their recommendation.
turns.pulledBy: The chair is unavailable and the observations have been verified.
turns.writesBack: The briefing records the observations and leaves the recommendation pending.
